menu.note: Roast the salmon and cook the quinoa Sunday; Tuesday is a reheat.
Also made Sunday. It thickens overnight, so loosen it with water when reheating.
No cooking — assembled from the pantry when the batch food runs out.
Buy the trout Saturday where possible. If it comes with the Sunday shop, freeze it on arrival and thaw it in the refrigerator Friday night.

notes: Sunday is the shop-and-batch-cook day: the salmon bowls and the lentil stew are both made then and cover four days. Thursday through Saturday are cooked fresh. Three fatty-fish meals clear the two-per-week floor, and every meal leans on turmeric, ginger, or garlic in cooking amounts. No tree nut is used anywhere this week; seeds and sunflower seed butter do that job. The seed butter is the one jarred product here, so buy a brand made in a dedicated nut-free facility and read its allergen statement — shared grinding lines are common. Planned around the fruit you already have: strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, blackberries, and bananas. Both fruit snacks are made on Sunday, because none of this fruit would survive to Saturday. It all still appears on the shopping list — the list is derived from the recipes, so nothing filters it out — so cross off whichever of the five you already have enough of. The one timing catch is Saturday's trout: raw fish cannot wait in the refrigerator from Sunday, so buy it that day or freeze it and thaw it Friday night.
